title: Weezing Might Be Two Koffing Fused Together
premise: Weezing can form when two Koffing meet different poison gases and fuse over many years.
audiencePromise: See two Koffing fuse into Weezing over many years.
openLoop: Does Weezing evolve from one Koffing, or can two Koffing become it together?
payoff: Weezing may have two origins: years of gas-driven fusion or a rare sudden mutation.
engagementQuestion: Which origin feels stranger: slow fusion or sudden mutation?

voice.instructions: Sound like a knowledgeable fan sharing a strange discovery. Keep the pace quick, warm, and clear. Stress fused, many years, and rarely. Leave a brief pause before the final choice.

scenes.headline: TWO KOFFING CAN FUSE
scenes.narration: Two Koffing can fuse into Weezing over many years.
scenes.caption: TWO KOFFING → ONE WEEZING

scenes.headline: TWO GASES MEET
scenes.narration: First, two Koffing encounter two different kinds of poison gas.
scenes.caption: DIFFERENT POISON GASES

scenes.headline: YEARS START THE FUSION
scenes.narration: Over many years, those gases meet, and the bodies slowly fuse.
scenes.caption: A FUSION THAT TAKES YEARS

scenes.headline: ONE WEEZING FORMS
scenes.narration: The result is Weezing, formed when two Koffing fuse.
scenes.caption: TWO BECOME ONE

scenes.headline: RARELY, IT HAPPENS FAST
scenes.narration: Very rarely, a mutation makes two small Koffing become conjoined Weezing.
scenes.caption: SUDDEN MUTATION

scenes.headline: WHICH ORIGIN IS STRANGER?
scenes.narration: Which origin feels stranger: slow fusion or sudden mutation?
scenes.caption: SLOW FUSION OR SUDDEN MUTATION?
